name: A photograph of a man who is not Obadiah Mott
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. C4, from the drawer in the empty office. Gone after Act IV opens: packed in his case (doc 121 N-5; errata 250).

LOOK_AT.say: A photograph of Obadiah Mott, discoverer of the Consolation strike. There were forty of him in the drawer.
repeat: He has a very good collar. Mr. Sheng has the same gentleman in his window, advertising the collar.
Nobody in Consolation knows what Mott looked like. This is what they have agreed to remember instead.
Nothing. He has the look of a man who would not say much, and he does not.

lostNote: Packed (doc 121 N-5; errata 250): Act IV opens with his case packed on the bed (doc 57: "there was less to pack than there was to leave"), and a paper that is done with is in it. It leaves the inventory when ACT reaches 4.
